This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

38	### 4.1 plan_step 预算分配：先 decode、后 prefill、再准入
39	
40	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
41	
42	`plan_step` 回答一个问题：**"下一步算什么？"**——注意它只做决定，不做时间，也不真正"算"任何 token。它的产出是一份不可变的施工图 `StepPlan`，真正推进状态要等 `complete_step`（见 4.3）。
43	
44	这个"规划/完成"两段式是刻意的架构选择：把"装什么"（纯逻辑、确定性）与"这一步要花多久"（时间模型）解耦。在 profile 车道里，`lib.rs` 正是插在 plan 与 complete 之间，拿 `plan.shape()` 去查计时网格、睡到预计时刻才调 `complete_step`（见 4.4.3）。

47	
48	1. **decode 优先**：所有已在 `Decode` 阶段的 running 请求，每个预留 1 个 token，绝不因为 prefill 挤占而掉拍。
49	2. **running prefill 其次**：已在 `Prefill` 阶段的请求按进入顺序分走剩余预算。
50	3. **新请求准入最后**：在剩余预算和 `max_num_seqs` 双重余量内，按 FCFS（先来先服务）从 `waiting` 队首准入。

53	
54	```

56	  若已有 in_flight 步        → Err（一次只能有一步在飞）
57	  若 running、waiting 全空   → 返回 None（引擎空闲）
58	
59	  budget = max_num_batched_tokens
60	  ① decode 循环：遍历 running，每个 Decode 阶段且未被取消的请求
61	       budget -= 1；累计 context_tokens 之和
62	  ② prefill 循环：遍历 running，每个 Prefill 阶段的请求
63	       tokens = scheduled_prefill_tokens(policy, 剩余, budget)
64	       tokens == 0 → 标记 prefill_blocked，停止（后续 running prefill 也不再分）
65	       否则 budget -= tokens
66	  ③ 准入循环：当 !prefill_blocked 且 budget > 0

68	       取队首请求；空 prompt 直接进 Decode（占 1 预算），
69	       否则按 scheduled_prefill_tokens 进 Prefill；
70	       分不到 token 就 break（不跳过队首去看后面的请求）

72	  shape = (decode 请求数, decode 上下文之和, 本步 prefill token 数)
73	  自检：shape 非空；decode ≤ max_num_seqs；总量 ≤ max_num_batched_tokens
74	  存为 in_flight，返回 &StepPlan
75	```

135	答案：两个原因。其一是 FCFS 公平性：waiting 准入严格从队首开始，如果被阻塞的 running prefill 之后放行更小的 waiting 请求，等于让后来者插队；其二是预算语义：`tokens == 0` 而 `remaining_budget > 0` 只会发生在 `Whole` 策略下"剩余 prefill 大于剩余预算"，此时继续搜刮预算只会让被阻塞者等更久。宁可本步收尾，下一步预算重置后再推进。

141	### 4.2 scheduled_prefill_tokens 与 PrefillPolicy：一次调度给多少
142	
143	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
144	
145	`scheduled_prefill_tokens` 是一个不到 20 行的纯函数，却是两条 prefill 策略的分水岭。它回答："这个请求这一步能装多少 prefill token？"
146	
147	- **`Whole`（整块）**：要么全装，要么不装。`remaining <= budget` 时装 `remaining`，否则 0。
148	- **`Chunked { max_chunk_tokens }`（分块）**：装 \(\min(\text{remaining},\ \text{max\_chunk\_tokens},\ \text{budget})\)，永远尽量推进。
149	
150	策略定义在 [src/profile.rs:293-298](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L293-L298)，是 `SchedulerProfile` 的一部分，随 JSON 档案一起加载（serde tag 为 `mode`，即 `{"mode": "whole"}` 或 `{"mode": "chunked", "max_chunk_tokens": N}`）。
151	
152	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
153	
154	```
155	scheduled_prefill_tokens(policy, remaining, budget):
156	  Whole                     → remaining <= budget ? remaining : 0
157	  Chunked { max_chunk }     → min(remaining, max_chunk, budget)
158	```
159	
160	两条策略的后果对比：
161	
162	| 维度 | Whole | Chunked |
163	|------|-------|---------|
164	| 长 prompt 的命运 | prompt > `max_num_batched_tokens` 且要输出 → 提交即被 preflight 拒绝（u2-l3 的 `WholePrefillExceedsStepBudget`） | 逐块推进，永不饿死 |
165	| 步数 | 少（一次装完） | 多（prompt ÷ max_chunk_tokens 向上取整的 prefill 段数） |
166	| 单步 shape | 大起大落（整段 prompt 一次入步） | 平滑（每步 prefill ≤ max_chunk_tokens） |
167	| 对 running decode 的延迟 | 一次大 prefill 步可能把步时拉长 | 步型受控，decode 掉拍风险小 |
168	| 输出集合 | 与 Chunked **完全相同**（见 4.2.4 与综合实践） | 同左 |
169	
170	最后一行是本讲最重要的不变量：**chunk 大小只改变"步怎么切"，不改变"最终算了什么"**。这解释了为什么 `chunk_cap_changes_same_step_admission_without_changing_outputs` 这个测试名里敢写 "without changing outputs"。

215	### 4.3 complete_step 推进语义：prefill 收尾产首 token、decode 逐 token、完成即出队
216	
217	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
218	
219	`complete_step` 是"施工"：按 `StepPlan` 把状态推进一格，并把发生的事情以 `StepOutcome` 报告出来。它必须与 `plan_step` 严格交替——调 complete 必须传入当前在飞步骤的 `StepId`，传错即 `Err`。
220	
221	三个推进规则：
222	
223	1. **prefill 推进**：`remaining_prefill_tokens -= tokens`、`context_tokens += tokens`。当 remaining 归零，请求迁移到 `Decode`，并且**立刻产出第 1 个输出 token**——这就是源码注释里说的"最后一段 prefill 的 logits 直接产出首个输出 token，再单独走一步 decode 会凭空多出一个 TTFT 步"。
224	2. **decode 推进**：`context_tokens += 1`（刚生成的 token 的 KV 并入上下文）、`generated_tokens += 1`，产出 `token_index`（1-based）。
225	3. **收割**：`generated_tokens == output_tokens` 的请求进 `finished`；被标记取消的请求全部进 `cancelled`；两者随后从 `running` 里物理移除。
226	
227	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
228	
229	```
230	complete_step(step_id):
231	  校验 in_flight 存在且 id 匹配 → 取出 plan
232	  ① 按 plan.prefill 逐条：
233	       找到 running 中的请求；被取消 → 跳过
234	       校验 phase==Prefill、0 < tokens <= remaining（防陈旧计划）
235	       remaining -= tokens；ctx += tokens；记录 PrefillProgress
236	       若 remaining == 0：
237	         phase → Decode；generated_tokens += 1；产出 token_index
238	         若 generated == output → finished
239	  ② 按 plan.decode 逐条：
240	       找到请求；被取消 → 跳过
241	       校验 phase==Decode、ctx == work.context_tokens、generated < output
242	       ctx += 1；generated += 1；产出 token_index
243	       若 generated == output → finished
244	  ③ cancelled = 所有 cancel_requested 的 running 请求
245	     running.retain(非取消 且 未 finished)
246	```
247	
248	TTFT 的算术：对一个 prompt 长 \(p\)、输出 \(k\) 的请求，从准入到首 token 需要 \(\lceil p / c \rceil\) 步（\(c\) 为每步实际装进的 prefill 量），而**首 token 出现在最后一段 prefill 所在的那一步**，不需要额外一步 decode。若没有这条规则，TTFT 会多一个整步。

252	id 匹配守卫：[src/worker.rs:456-468](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L456-L468)——`complete_step` 要求传入的 id 与在飞步骤一致，`in_flight.take()` 把计划取走，保证一步恰好被结算一次。

254	prefill 推进与首 token：[src/worker.rs:476-518](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L476-L518)——先做防御校验（阶段正确、token 量在剩余范围内），再扣减 remaining、累加 ctx，压入一条 `PrefillProgress`。关键在 [src/worker.rs:502-517](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L502-L517)：remaining 归零时阶段迁移到 `Decode`，`generated_tokens` 从 0 加到 1 并立刻 push 一条 `GeneratedToken { token_index: 1 }`；若 `output_tokens == 1`（比如脚本化补全只要一个 token 的场景），同一步就进 `finished`。注释（[src/worker.rs:504-505](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L504-L505)）写明了动机：单独再走一步 decode 会给 TTFT 凭空加一步。

256	decode 推进：[src/worker.rs:520-550](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L520-L550)——校验三元组里最值得注意的是 `request.context_tokens == work.context_tokens`：计划里记录的 ctx 是"这次 decode query 之前已有的 KV 长度"，若结算时对不上，说明计划与状态已经脱节（调用方用错了顺序），立即报错。随后 `ctx += 1`（新 token 的 KV 入池）、`generated += 1`，压入 `GeneratedToken`，同样在追平 `output_tokens` 时进 `finished`。`generated_tokens < output_tokens` 的校验则保证不会超发。

258	取消收割与出队：[src/worker.rs:552-559](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L552-L559)——所有 `cancel_requested` 的 running 请求（无论本步是否被 plan 跳过）统一进 `cancelled`；`retain` 一次性移除取消与完成的请求。终态 = 离开 `running`，这与 u2-l3"终态不是枚举变体"的设计闭环。

298	### 4.4 StepPlan / StepOutcome / StepShape：一步的契约与计时预测的键
299	
300	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
301	
302	三个类型构成 worker 与外界（以及 worker 与计时模型）之间的契约：
303	
304	- **`StepPlan<I>`**：施工图。字段全部私有，只能经 `id()` / `shape()` / `admitted()` / `prefill()` / `decode()` 读取——`worker.rs` 不希望任何调用方在计划生成后篡改它。
305	- **`StepOutcome<I>`**：施工报告。四份清单：`prefill`（每请求的进度与剩余）、`generated`（每请求产出的 token 序号）、`finished`、`cancelled`。
306	- **`StepShape`**：把一步的**负载**压缩成三个数——`decode_reqs`（decode 请求数）、`sum_decode_ctx_tokens`（这些请求的上下文长度之和）、`prefill_tokens_in_step`（本步 prefill token 总数）。它**刻意丢弃请求身份**：两个完全不同的请求组合，只要负载三元组相同，对计时模型而言就是同一种步。
307	
308	`StepShape` 是本讲的桥：u3 单元将讲 `EngineProfile` 如何用它查 `TimingGrid` 做三线性插值得到 `duration_us`。丢身份正是为了让查表空间有限——请求 id 无限，负载组合有限。
309	
310	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
311	
312	```
313	StepPlan（不可变）
314	  ├─ id: StepId            —— 结算凭证，complete_step 必须对上
315	  ├─ shape: StepShape      —— 计时键：负载三元组
316	  ├─ admitted: Vec<I>      —— 本步新准入的请求（前端据此发"已受理"）
317	  ├─ prefill: Vec<PrefillWork>   —— (请求, 本步 prefill token 数)
318	  └─ decode: Vec<DecodeWork>     —— (请求, 该请求解码前 ctx 长度)
319	
320	StepOutcome（一次性报告）
321	  ├─ prefill: Vec<PrefillProgress>  —— (processed, remaining, ctx)
322	  ├─ generated: Vec<GeneratedToken> —— (请求, 1-based token_index)
323	  ├─ finished: Vec<I>
324	  └─ cancelled: Vec<I>
325	
326	StepShape（纯值，Copy）
327	  ├─ decode_reqs: u32
328	  ├─ sum_decode_ctx_tokens: u64
329	  └─ prefill_tokens_in_step: u32
330	```
331	
332	`StepShape` 的合法性约束（`SchedulerProfile::validate_shape`）：非空（decode 与 prefill 至少其一大于 0）、`decode_reqs <= max_num_seqs`、`decode_reqs + prefill_tokens_in_step <= max_num_batched_tokens`、`decode_reqs == 0` 时 `sum_decode_ctx_tokens` 必须为 0、`sum_decode_ctx_tokens <= decode_reqs × max_model_len`。`plan_step` 末尾的自检（4.1.3）与这套约束一一对应——worker 产出的每一步天然能通过计时模型的形状校验。
333	
334	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
335	
336	`StepPlan` 及其只读访问器：[src/worker.rs:108-142](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L108-L142)——字段私有 + `#[must_use]` 访问器，构造只发生在 `plan_step` 内部。`StepId` 是 `u64` 的新类型包装（[src/worker.rs:85-93](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L85-L93)），防止调用方拿裸整数伪造步骤凭证。
337	
338	`PrefillWork` / `DecodeWork`：[src/worker.rs:95-106](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L95-L106)——注意 `DecodeWork.context_tokens` 的文档注释："计算这次 decode query 之前已有的 KV 长度"，即 attention 的 query 长度恒为 1、KV 长度为该值。
339	
340	`StepOutcome` 三兄弟：[src/worker.rs:144-164](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L144-L164)——`PrefillProgress` 报告 processed/remaining/context 三元组，`GeneratedToken` 的 `token_index` 从 1 计起（对应 u2-l2 讲过的 profiled 车道"pending 反转存储按 1-based 取值"）。
341	
342	`StepShape` 定义：[src/profile.rs:300-305](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L300-L305)——`Copy` 纯值类型，放在 `profile.rs` 而非 `worker.rs`，因为它同时是计时预测的输入。形状校验在 [src/profile.rs:254-290](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L254-L290)，其中 `max_num_seqs <= max_num_batched_tokens` 的总约束在 [src/profile.rs:237-240](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L237-L240)（理由写得很直白：每个 decode 请求每步吃 1 token）。
343	
344	shape 作为计时键的用法：[src/lib.rs:335-368](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L335-L368)——`ProfiledRuntime::step` 在 `plan_step` 之后立刻 `estimate_step(plan.shape())`（[src/lib.rs:338-340](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L338-L340)），把估出的微秒换算成 `ready_at` 时刻存进 `in_flight`；下一轮循环发现未到点就按 `WAIT_SLICE` 切片睡（u2-l1 讲过），到点才 `complete_step`。`estimate_step` 本体在 [src/profile.rs:101-119](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L101-L119)：先 `validate_shape`，再查 coverage，最后网格插值——细节留给 u3。
345	
346	集成侧的回放器：[tests/frontend_e2e.rs:299-367](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L299-L367) 的 `replay_profiled_worker` 把三个固定请求喂给 worker，循环 plan→estimate→complete，把每步的 shape、估时、admitted/prefill/decode 记进 `PlanTrace`（[tests/frontend_e2e.rs:269-276](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L269-L276)）；[tests/frontend_e2e.rs:405-440](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/frontend_e2e.rs#L405-L440) 断言两次回放逐位相同、且必须出现过 prefill 步、decode 步与**互不相同的估时**——最后一条正是在验证"shape 不同 → 计价不同"。
347	
348	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
349	
350	**实践目标**：亲眼看到"同一负载 → 同一步时"的键语义，以及 worker 回放的确定性。
351	
352	1. 阅读 `replay_profiled_worker`（链接同上），注意它复用 `profile.scheduler` 构造 `WorkerState`——调度参数与计时数据同源，这是 profile 车道"档案是唯一真相"（u1-l2）的体现。
353	2. 运行（纯 CPU，无需 GPU，但需要编译整个 crate）：
354	
355	```bash
356	cargo test --release -p pegainfer-sim --test frontend_e2e profiled_worker_replay_is_deterministic_and_bounded -- --nocapture
357	```
358	
359	3. 在你自己的工作副本里给 `PlanTrace` 加一行打印（或写个新测试收集 trace），找出 shape 不同的两步，核对它们的 `duration_us` 不同；再找出（若存在）shape 相同的两步，核对 `duration_us` 逐位相同。
360	4. 对照 `online-step-gate.json` fixture（[tests/fixtures/online-step-gate.json](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/tests/fixtures/online-step-gate.json)）里的 `scheduler` 段与 `grid` 段，确认回放中出现的每个 shape 都落在 grid 的覆盖域内（u3-l2 会展开"覆盖域"概念）。
361	
362	**需要观察的现象**：两次回放的 `PlanTrace` 列表完全相等；trace 中既有 `prefill_tokens_in_step > 0` 的混合步，也有纯 decode 步；不同 shape 对应不同 `duration_us`。
363	
364	**预期结果**：测试通过（仓库既有测试）；打印观察**待本地验证**。
365	
366	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
367	
368	**练习 1**：`decode_reqs = 3, sum_decode_ctx_tokens = 10, prefill_tokens_in_step = 0` 与 `decode_reqs = 1, sum_decode_ctx_tokens = 10, prefill_tokens_in_step = 0` 是同一种步吗？计时模型怎么看？
369	
370	答案：对 worker 不是（涉及不同请求组合），对计时模型是**两种**不同的步——shape 三元组不同就是不同的键。前者是"3 个短上下文请求各decode 一步"，后者是"1 个长上下文请求 decode 一步"；attention 的计算量分别近似 \(3 \times\)（短 KV）与 \(1 \times 10\)（长 KV），网格插值允许它们定价不同。
371	
372	**练习 2**：为什么 `sum_decode_ctx_tokens` 用 `u64`，而另两个字段用 `u32`？
373	
374	答案：它是多个请求上下文之和，可能远超单请求上限——`validate_shape` 里它的天花板是 `decode_reqs × max_model_len`（[src/profile.rs:280-288](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L280-L288)），两个 `u32` 相乘必须用 `u64` 承接；`plan_step` 累加时也全程 `checked_add`（[src/worker.rs:345-347](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L345-L347)）。
375	
376	**练习 3**：`StepPlan` 为什么不直接携带"这步该睡多久"？
377	
378	答案：职责分离。`worker.rs` 是纯逻辑状态机，对时间一无所知；时间属于 `profile.rs` 的计时模型。`lib.rs` 的 ProfiledRuntime 在 plan 与 complete 之间插入了"查 shape → 估时 → 定 ready_at → 睡觉"的环节（[src/lib.rs:338-368](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L338-L368)）。这样同一个 `WorkerState` 可以配任何档案（或未来配真实计时）而不改一行调度代码——4.4.4 实践里 `replay_profiled_worker` 直接复用它就是证明。
379	
380	## 5. 综合实践
381	
382	**任务**：写一个"chunk 上限回放对比"测试，亲手验证本讲的核心不变量——**chunk 大小改变步的切法，不改变最终输出集合**。
383	
384	样板是仓库既有的 [src/worker.rs:750-929](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L750-L929) `chunk_cap_changes_same_step_admission_without_changing_outputs`（它对比 cap=6 与 cap=2）。我们换一组参数与请求，对比 **cap=4 与 cap=1**。
385	
386	**场景设定**（手推锚点已给出，均由 4.1–4.3 的规则逐步推出）：
387	
388	- 调度器：`scheduler(max_num_seqs=4, max_num_batched_tokens=8, max_model_len=128, Chunked { max_chunk_tokens })`
389	- 先提交 req1 `(prompt=0, output=3)`、req2 `(prompt=0, output=3)`，走完第一步；
390	- 再提交 req3 `(prompt=10, output=2)`（本场景的"长 prompt"）、req4 `(prompt=1, output=1)`；
391	- 循环 plan→complete 直到 `is_idle()`，逐步记录 shape / admitted / prefill / generated / finished。
392	
393	**操作步骤**（以下测试代码为**示例代码**，加到你自己的工作副本 `src/worker.rs` 测试模块中）：
394	
395	```rust
396	#[test]
397	fn cap_one_vs_cap_four_replay_changes_steps_not_outputs() {
398	    struct Trace { shapes: Vec<StepShape>, generated: Vec<(u32, u32)>, finished: Vec<u32>, steps: usize }
399	
400	    fn replay(max_chunk_tokens: u32) -> Trace {
401	        let mut worker = WorkerState::new(scheduler(4, 8, 128, PrefillPolicy::Chunked { max_chunk_tokens })).unwrap();
402	        worker.submit(request(1, 0, 3)).unwrap();
403	        worker.submit(request(2, 0, 3)).unwrap();
404	        let mut shapes = Vec::new();
405	        let mut generated = Vec::new();
406	        let mut finished = Vec::new();
407	        let mut steps = 0;
408	        let mut drain = |worker: &mut WorkerState<u32>, shapes: &mut Vec<StepShape>,
409	                         generated: &mut Vec<(u32, u32)>, finished: &mut Vec<u32>| -> bool {
410	            let Some(plan) = worker.plan_step().unwrap() else { return false };
411	            shapes.push(plan.shape());
412	            // cap 不改变"每条 prefill work 不超过上限"这一性质
413	            assert!(plan.prefill().iter().all(|w| w.tokens <= max_chunk_tokens));
414	            let id = plan.id();
415	            let outcome = worker.complete_step(id).unwrap();
416	            generated.extend(outcome.generated.into_iter().map(|t| (t.request_id, t.token_index)));
417	            finished.extend(outcome.finished);
418	            true
419	        };
420	        // 第 0 步：两个空 prompt 请求直接进 decode
421	        assert!(drain(&mut worker, &mut shapes, &mut generated, &mut finished));
422	        worker.submit(request(3, 10, 2)).unwrap();
423	        worker.submit(request(4, 1, 1)).unwrap();
424	        while drain(&mut worker, &mut shapes, &mut generated, &mut finished) {}
425	        assert!(worker.is_idle());
426	        let mut finished = finished; finished.sort_unstable();
427	        let mut generated = generated; generated.sort_unstable();
428	        Trace { shapes, generated, finished, steps }
429	    }
430	    // ...对比断言见下
431	}
432	```
433	
434	（注意闭包捕获 `max_chunk_tokens` 需要它按值拷贝进闭包或改成参数传入——示例从简，写测试时把 `drain` 改成接收 cap 的普通内部函数更清晰，可参考原测试的 `record_step` 写法。）
435	
436	**手推锚点**（用于核对你跑出来的 trace；这些值由本讲规则逐步推出，属"预期结果"，**待本地验证**）：
437	
438	| 观察点 | cap=4 | cap=1 |
439	|--------|-------|-------|
440	| 总步数 | 5（id 0..4） | 12（id 0..11） |
441	| 第 0 步 shape | `{decode_reqs: 2, sum_ctx: 0, prefill: 0}`，admitted `[1,2]` | 同左 |
442	| 第 1 步 shape | `{2, 2, 5}`，admitted `[3,4]`，prefill `[(3,4),(4,1)]` | `{2, 2, 2}`，admitted `[3,4]`，prefill `[(3,1),(4,1)]` |
443	| 第 2 步 shape | `{2, 4, 4}`（req1/req2 本步 finished） | `{2, 4, 1}`（req1/req2 本步 finished） |
444	| 第 3 步起 | 仅剩 req3：第 3 步 prefill 2 token 收尾并产 `token_index 1`，第 4 步 decode 产 `token_index 2` → finished | 仅剩 req3：第 3..9 步每步 1 个 prefill token（shape `{0,0,1}`），第 10 步收尾产首 token，第 11 步 decode → finished |
445	| 最终 finished | `[1,2,3,4]` | `[1,2,3,4]` |
446	| 最终 generated（排序后） | `[(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1),(3,2),(4,1)]` 共 9 条 | 与左**完全相同** |
447	
448	**需要观察的现象与断言要点**：
449	
450	1. `cap_one.finished == cap_four.finished == [1,2,3,4]`；`cap_one.generated == cap_four.generated`（排序后逐位相等）——输出集合不变。
451	2. `cap_one.steps == 12`、`cap_four.steps == 5`——步数差约等于"长 prompt 被切成多少段"。
452	3. 每条 prefill work 的 `tokens <= max_chunk_tokens`；每步 `decode_reqs + prefill_tokens_in_step <= 8`、`decode_reqs <= 4`。
453	4. cap=1 的 trace 中出现一串 `decode_reqs == 0` 的纯 prefill 步（只剩 req3 时的 `{0,0,1}`）——这正好印证 `validate_shape` 的"非空步"约束与 `sum_decode_ctx_tokens == 0 ⟺ decode_reqs == 0` 约束都能被真实序列满足。
454	5. 思考题：为什么第 1 步两种 cap 都把 req3 和 req4 **同时**准入？（原测试里 cap=6 只准入 `[3]`。）答案：decode 用掉 2 个预算后还剩 6；cap=4 时 req3 取 4、剩 2 ≥ 1，req4 还进得来；cap=1 时各取 1 更是宽裕。原测试 cap=6 下 req3 一次取 6 把预算吃到 0，准入循环因 `remaining_budget > 0` 不成立而停——挡住 req4 的是**预算**，不是 seq 上限。
455	
456	## 6. 本讲小结
457	
458	- `plan_step` 只做决定不做时间：**decode 优先**（每请求 1 token，靠 `max_num_seqs <= max_num_batched_tokens` 这条 profile 约束保证永远付得起）→ running prefill 按序分块 → waiting 按 FCFS 准入，`max_num_seqs` 与 `max_num_batched_tokens` 是两道独立的闸门。
459	- `scheduled_prefill_tokens` 是两条策略的分水岭：`Whole` 全有或全无（装不下的请求在 preflight 就被拒，运行中永不饿死），`Chunked` 恒取 \(\min(\text{剩余}, \text{cap}, \text{预算})\) 永远推进。
460	- `complete_step` 三段推进：prefill 扣 remaining 加 ctx；**remaining 归零当步迁移到 Decode 并直接产出 `token_index 1`**（否则 TTFT 凭空多一步）；decode 每步 ctx+1、generated+1；追平 output 即 finished，与取消请求一起被 `retain` 出队。
461	- `StepPlan` 不可变（私有字段 + 只读访问器），`StepId` 是结算凭证；`StepOutcome` 是一次性施工报告，`generated` 里 prefill 产出的 token 排在 decode 产出的前面。
462	- `StepShape = (decode_reqs, sum_decode_ctx_tokens, prefill_tokens_in_step)` **丢掉请求身份**，把一步负载压成计时预测的查表键——`lib.rs` 的 ProfiledRuntime 正是插在 plan 与 complete 之间用 shape 估时、睡到 `ready_at` 才结算。
463	- 核心不变量（综合实践验证）：**chunk 上限只改变步的切法与步数，不改变最终 generated/finished 集合**。
464	
465	## 7. 下一步学习建议
466	
467	本讲结束后，你已经完整掌握 worker 的"装什么、怎么推进"。接下来两条路：
468	
469	1. **u2-l5（取消语义）**：`cancel` 的四种返回（`Cancelled`/`Deferred`/`AlreadyRequested`/`NotFound`）如何与 `plan_step` 跳过 `cancel_requested` 请求、`complete_step` 统一收割 `cancelled` 的机制配合——本讲已多次碰到这个标记，下一讲把它讲透。
470	2. **u3 单元（引擎档案）**：本讲反复出现的 `StepShape` 在 u3-l2（`SchedulerProfile`/`PredictorCoverage` 校验）与 u3-l3（`TimingGrid` 三线性插值）里从"键"变成主角；u3-l4 再把 `ProfiledRuntime` 的完整在线车道（准入 → 定价 → 睡眠 → 结算）合拢。
471	
472	建议继续精读的源码：`src/worker.rs` 的测试模块（本讲引用的三个测试是手推能力的最好标尺），以及 `tests/frontend_e2e.rs` 的 `replay_profiled_worker`——它示范了"worker + profile"这对组合的标准用法。

# WorkerState（下）：plan_step 的预算分配与 complete_step 的推进

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u2-l3）我们讲完了 `WorkerState` 的"静态"部分：请求如何提交、`preflight` 如何拒绝、`RequestPhase` 三阶段如何迁移。本讲进入它的"动态"核心——调度器的每一次心跳：

1. **`plan_step` 的预算分配**：一步之内先装 decode、再装 prefill、最后准入新请求，`max_num_seqs` 与 `max_num_batched_tokens` 双上限如何共同决定"这一步装什么"。
2. **`complete_step` 的推进语义**：prefill 收尾时为什么直接产出第一个输出 token、decode 如何逐 token 推进、完成的请求如何出队。
3. **`StepPlan` / `StepOutcome` / `StepShape` 三个契约类型**：尤其是 `StepShape`——它把一步的负载压缩成三个数字，正是后续（u3 单元）计时预测的查表键。

学完本讲，你应该能拿一份 `SchedulerProfile` 和一组请求，**手推**出完整的步序列：每一步的 shape、每一步谁被准入、谁产出了第几个 token、总共多少步。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲建立在 u2-l3 的概念之上，先花一分钟回顾：

- **`WorkerRequest<I>`**：`{ id, prompt_tokens, output_tokens }`，请求的全部静态属性。
- **`RequestPhase`**：`Waiting`（在排队队列里）→ `Prefill`（正在算 prompt 的 KV）→ `Decode`（正在逐 token 生成）。终态不是枚举变体，而是从 `running` 里物理移除。
- **`SchedulerProfile`**（定义在 [src/profile.rs:213-221](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L213-L221)）：调度器的四个旋钮——`max_num_seqs`（最多同时跑几个请求）、`max_num_batched_tokens`（一步最多算多少 token）、`max_model_len`（单请求总长度上限）、`prefill`（`Whole` 或 `Chunked { max_chunk_tokens }`）。
- **step contract**（u1-l3 建立）：前端驱动 `Scheduler::step`，引擎一步最多给每个请求吐一个 token。本讲的 `plan_step`/`complete_step` 就是这个契约在 worker 内部的"一步"的两半。

再补两个本讲要用的直觉：

- **token 预算（budget）**：真实引擎一步要发动一次 GPU kernel，这次 kernel 能装的 token 数有上限。`max_num_batched_tokens` 就是这个上限的抽象。decode 一个请求一步恰好消耗 1 个 token（算一个新 token 的 KV 与 logits），prefill 则按块消耗。
- **"先 decode 后 prefill"**：这是 vLLM V1 调度器的真实策略。已经进入 decode 的请求对延迟最敏感（用户正盯着逐字输出），所以它们的 1 token/步必须先预留；剩下的预算才分给 prefill 和新请求。源码里专门留有注释说明这一点。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 plan_step 预算分配：先 decode、后 prefill、再准入

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`plan_step` 回答一个问题：**"下一步算什么？"**——注意它只做决定，不做时间，也不真正"算"任何 token。它的产出是一份不可变的施工图 `StepPlan`，真正推进状态要等 `complete_step`（见 4.3）。

这个"规划/完成"两段式是刻意的架构选择：把"装什么"（纯逻辑、确定性）与"这一步要花多久"（时间模型）解耦。在 profile 车道里，`lib.rs` 正是插在 plan 与 complete 之间，拿 `plan.shape()` 去查计时网格、睡到预计时刻才调 `complete_step`（见 4.4.3）。

预算分配遵循三条铁律：

1. **decode 优先**：所有已在 `Decode` 阶段的 running 请求，每个预留 1 个 token，绝不因为 prefill 挤占而掉拍。
2. **running prefill 其次**：已在 `Prefill` 阶段的请求按进入顺序分走剩余预算。
3. **新请求准入最后**：在剩余预算和 `max_num_seqs` 双重余量内，按 FCFS（先来先服务）从 `waiting` 队首准入。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```
plan_step():
  若已有 in_flight 步        → Err（一次只能有一步在飞）
  若 running、waiting 全空   → 返回 None（引擎空闲）

  budget = max_num_batched_tokens
  ① decode 循环：遍历 running，每个 Decode 阶段且未被取消的请求
       budget -= 1；累计 context_tokens 之和
  ② prefill 循环：遍历 running，每个 Prefill 阶段的请求
       tokens = scheduled_prefill_tokens(policy, 剩余, budget)
       tokens == 0 → 标记 prefill_blocked，停止（后续 running prefill 也不再分）
       否则 budget -= tokens
  ③ 准入循环：当 !prefill_blocked 且 budget > 0
       且 running.len() < max_num_seqs 且 waiting 非空：
       取队首请求；空 prompt 直接进 Decode（占 1 预算），
       否则按 scheduled_prefill_tokens 进 Prefill；
       分不到 token 就 break（不跳过队首去看后面的请求）

  shape = (decode 请求数, decode 上下文之和, 本步 prefill token 数)
  自检：shape 非空；decode ≤ max_num_seqs；总量 ≤ max_num_batched_tokens
  存为 in_flight，返回 &StepPlan
```

预算的消耗可以写成一行不等式，plan 结束时必须成立：

\[ n_{decode} + n_{prefill\_tokens} \le \text{max\_num\_batched\_tokens}, \qquad n_{decode} \le \text{max\_num\_seqs} \]

还有一个隐含的不变量：decode 循环开头的 `ensure!(remaining_budget > 0)` 理论上永远不会触发，因为 `SchedulerProfile::validate` 强制了 `max_num_seqs <= max_num_batched_tokens`（每个 decode 请求每步恰耗 1 token，所以 decode 永远付得起）——这条 profile 级约束正是"decode 优先"策略成立的前提。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

入口守卫与空闲短路：[src/worker.rs:319-332](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L319-L332)——`plan_step` 拒绝在还有一步在飞时再规划；两边队列全空时返回 `Ok(None)`，调用方以此感知"没有活干"。`next_step_id` 用 `checked_add` 防溢出。

decode 优先循环：[src/worker.rs:337-352](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L337-L352)——注释直说 vLLM V1 的策略：所有 running decode 先调度，剩余 token 预算才花在 prefill 上。每个请求扣 1 预算、把它的 `context_tokens` 累进 `sum_decode_ctx_tokens`（这个和数将进入 `StepShape`，见 4.4）。

running prefill 循环：[src/worker.rs:354-376](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L354-L376)——按 `running` 向量顺序（即准入顺序）给每个 Prefill 阶段请求分 `scheduled_prefill_tokens` 算出的量；分到 0 就置 `prefill_blocked` 并 break。注意这是**队首阻塞**：第一个分不到的 prefill 会挡住后面所有 running prefill，保证先来的请求先走完。

准入循环：[src/worker.rs:378-423](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L378-L423)——四个条件共同控制循环：没有 prefill 被阻塞、还有预算、`running.len() < max_num_seqs`、还有排队请求。队首请求若 `remaining_prefill_tokens == 0`（空 prompt）直接进 `Decode`、只占 1 预算（[src/worker.rs:408-413](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L408-L413)）；否则按策略分 prefill token，分不到就 `break`——**不会跳过队首去搜刮后面更小的请求**，FCFS 语义严格到不越过一个无法准入的队首。准入的请求立刻 `push` 进 `running`，所以同一步内准入的请求与老请求在 `StepPlan` 里平起平坐。

shape 组装与自检：[src/worker.rs:425-453](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L425-L453)——用 `u32::try_from` 把 decode 数收窄后构造 `StepShape`，随后三条 `ensure!` 复核预算双上限与"非空步"（有请求在却规划出空步是逻辑 bug，直接报错而不是静默空转），最后存入 `in_flight` 并返回引用。

答案：两个原因。其一是 FCFS 公平性：waiting 准入严格从队首开始，如果被阻塞的 running prefill 之后放行更小的 waiting 请求，等于让后来者插队；其二是预算语义：`tokens == 0` 而 `remaining_budget > 0` 只会发生在 `Whole` 策略下"剩余 prefill 大于剩余预算"，此时继续搜刮预算只会让被阻塞者等更久。宁可本步收尾，下一步预算重置后再推进。

**练习 3**：`plan_step` 为什么返回 `Result<Option<&StepPlan>>` 而不是直接 `Option<StepPlan>`？

答案：`Err` 留给调用方契约违规与内部不变量被打破（重复规划、预算超限、溢出）——这些是 bug，应当带上下文上抛（u2-l1 讲过错误上抛而非 panic 的风格）；`Ok(None)` 则是正常业务信号"引擎空闲，没有下一步"，`lib.rs` 的 ProfiledRuntime 据此直接返回继续下一轮。返回引用是因为计划已存进 `self.in_flight`，调用方拿着引用读取即可，`complete_step` 再按 `StepId` 结算。

### 4.2 scheduled_prefill_tokens 与 PrefillPolicy：一次调度给多少

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`scheduled_prefill_tokens` 是一个不到 20 行的纯函数，却是两条 prefill 策略的分水岭。它回答："这个请求这一步能装多少 prefill token？"

- **`Whole`（整块）**：要么全装，要么不装。`remaining <= budget` 时装 `remaining`，否则 0。
- **`Chunked { max_chunk_tokens }`（分块）**：装 \(\min(\text{remaining},\ \text{max\_chunk\_tokens},\ \text{budget})\)，永远尽量推进。

策略定义在 [src/profile.rs:293-298](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/profile.rs#L293-L298)，是 `SchedulerProfile` 的一部分，随 JSON 档案一起加载（serde tag 为 `mode`，即 `{"mode": "whole"}` 或 `{"mode": "chunked", "max_chunk_tokens": N}`）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```
scheduled_prefill_tokens(policy, remaining, budget):
  Whole                     → remaining <= budget ? remaining : 0
  Chunked { max_chunk }     → min(remaining, max_chunk, budget)
```

两条策略的后果对比：

| 维度 | Whole | Chunked |
|------|-------|---------|
| 长 prompt 的命运 | prompt > `max_num_batched_tokens` 且要输出 → 提交即被 preflight 拒绝（u2-l3 的 `WholePrefillExceedsStepBudget`） | 逐块推进，永不饿死 |
| 步数 | 少（一次装完） | 多（prompt ÷ max_chunk_tokens 向上取整的 prefill 段数） |
| 单步 shape | 大起大落（整段 prompt 一次入步） | 平滑（每步 prefill ≤ max_chunk_tokens） |
| 对 running decode 的延迟 | 一次大 prefill 步可能把步时拉长 | 步型受控，decode 掉拍风险小 |
| 输出集合 | 与 Chunked **完全相同**（见 4.2.4 与综合实践） | 同左 |

最后一行是本讲最重要的不变量：**chunk 大小只改变"步怎么切"，不改变"最终算了什么"**。这解释了为什么 `chunk_cap_changes_same_step_admission_without_changing_outputs` 这个测试名里敢写 "without changing outputs"。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

函数本体：[src/worker.rs:564-581](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/worker.rs#L564-L581)——`Whole` 分支是全有或全无；`Chunked` 分支一行三量取最小。注意它对 `remaining == 0` 的输入在 `Whole` 下返回 0（`0 <= budget` 恒真，返回 `remaining = 0`）——不过实践中不会发生：空 prompt 在准入时就直接进了 Decode，不进入 prefill 循环。

### 4.3 complete_step 推进语义：prefill 收尾产首 token、decode 逐 token、完成即出队

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`complete_step` 是"施工"：按 `StepPlan` 把状态推进一格，并把发生的事情以 `StepOutcome` 报告出来。它必须与 `plan_step` 严格交替——调 complete 必须传入当前在飞步骤的 `StepId`，传错即 `Err`。

三个推进规则：

1. **prefill 推进**：`remaining_prefill_tokens -= tokens`、`context_tokens += tokens`。当 remaining 归零，请求迁移到 `Decode`，并且**立刻产出第 1 个输出 token**——这就是源码注释里说的"最后一段 prefill 的 logits 直接产出首个输出 token，再单独走一步 decode 会凭空多出一个 TTFT 步"。
2. **decode 推进**：`context_tokens += 1`（刚生成的 token 的 KV 并入上下文）、`generated_tokens += 1`，产出 `token_index`（1-based）。
3. **收割**：`generated_tokens == output_tokens` 的请求进 `finished`；被标记取消的请求全部进 `cancelled`；两者随后从 `running` 里物理移除。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
complete_step(step_id):
  校验 in_flight 存在且 id 匹配 → 取出 plan
  ① 按 plan.prefill 逐条：
       找到 running 中的请求；被取消 → 跳过
       校验 phase==Prefill、0 < tokens <= remaining（防陈旧计划）
       remaining -= tokens；ctx += tokens；记录 PrefillProgress
       若 remaining == 0：
         phase → Decode；generated_tokens += 1；产出 token_index
         若 generated == output → finished
  ② 按 plan.decode 逐条：
       找到请求；被取消 → 跳过
       校验 phase==Decode、ctx == work.context_tokens、generated < output
       ctx += 1；generated += 1；产出 token_index
       若 generated == output → finished
  ③ cancelled = 所有 cancel_requested 的 running 请求
     running.retain(非取消 且 未 finished)
```

TTFT 的算术：对一个 prompt 长 \(p\)、输出 \(k\) 的请求，从准入到首 token 需要 \(\lceil p / c \rceil\) 步（\(c\) 为每步实际装进的 prefill 量），而**首 token 出现在最后一段 prefill 所在的那一步**，不需要额外一步 decode。若没有这条规则，TTFT 会多一个整步。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 decode 校验要求 `request.context_tokens == work.context_tokens`，而 prefill 校验没有对应条款？

**练习 2**：一个 `(prompt=2, output=2)` 的请求在 `Chunked { max_chunk_tokens: 1 }` 下，从准入到 finished 需要几步？每步各产出什么？

答案：4 步。步 1：prefill 1 token（remaining 2→1）；步 2：prefill 1 token（remaining→0）并产出 `token_index 1`；步 3：decode 产出 `token_index 2`，`generated == output` → finished。若 budget 允许同一步装更多（cap=2），则 2 步完成：步 1 prefill 全装完并产首 token，步 2 decode 产第二 token 即终结。

**练习 3**：`StepOutcome.finished` 收割后，同一个请求 id 还能再次出现在后续任何 StepPlan 里吗？

答案：不能。`retain` 已把它从 `running` 移除，而 `plan_step` 只从 `running` 与 `waiting` 取材；除非调用方对**同一 id** 再次 `submit`（允许——u2-l3 只禁止"仍然活跃"的 id 重复），它才会作为全新请求从头走 Waiting→Prefill→Decode。

### 4.4 StepPlan / StepOutcome / StepShape：一步的契约与计时预测的键

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

三个类型构成 worker 与外界（以及 worker 与计时模型）之间的契约：

- **`StepPlan<I>`**：施工图。字段全部私有，只能经 `id()` / `shape()` / `admitted()` / `prefill()` / `decode()` 读取——`worker.rs` 不希望任何调用方在计划生成后篡改它。
- **`StepOutcome<I>`**：施工报告。四份清单：`prefill`（每请求的进度与剩余）、`generated`（每请求产出的 token 序号）、`finished`、`cancelled`。
- **`StepShape`**：把一步的**负载**压缩成三个数——`decode_reqs`（decode 请求数）、`sum_decode_ctx_tokens`（这些请求的上下文长度之和）、`prefill_tokens_in_step`（本步 prefill token 总数）。它**刻意丢弃请求身份**：两个完全不同的请求组合，只要负载三元组相同，对计时模型而言就是同一种步。

`StepShape` 是本讲的桥：u3 单元将讲 `EngineProfile` 如何用它查 `TimingGrid` 做三线性插值得到 `duration_us`。丢身份正是为了让查表空间有限——请求 id 无限，负载组合有限。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```
StepPlan（不可变）
  ├─ id: StepId            —— 结算凭证，complete_step 必须对上
  ├─ shape: StepShape      —— 计时键：负载三元组
  ├─ admitted: Vec<I>      —— 本步新准入的请求（前端据此发"已受理"）
  ├─ prefill: Vec<PrefillWork>   —— (请求, 本步 prefill token 数)
  └─ decode: Vec<DecodeWork>     —— (请求, 该请求解码前 ctx 长度)

StepOutcome（一次性报告）
  ├─ prefill: Vec<PrefillProgress>  —— (processed, remaining, ctx)
  ├─ generated: Vec<GeneratedToken> —— (请求, 1-based token_index)
  ├─ finished: Vec<I>
  └─ cancelled: Vec<I>

StepShape（纯值，Copy）
  ├─ decode_reqs: u32
  ├─ sum_decode_ctx_tokens: u64
  └─ prefill_tokens_in_step: u32
```

`StepShape` 的合法性约束（`SchedulerProfile::validate_shape`）：非空（decode 与 prefill 至少其一大于 0）、`decode_reqs <= max_num_seqs`、`decode_reqs + prefill_tokens_in_step <= max_num_batched_tokens`、`decode_reqs == 0` 时 `sum_decode_ctx_tokens` 必须为 0、`sum_decode_ctx_tokens <= decode_reqs × max_model_len`。`plan_step` 末尾的自检（4.1.3）与这套约束一一对应——worker 产出的每一步天然能通过计时模型的形状校验。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
